generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The Employer shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of the e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contract value, minimum Rs500 and maximum Rs7,500
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender and the Employer will in no case be responsible for these costs.
Bidder should have valid registration with the Employees Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) under the EPF and Miscellaneous Provisions Act.

To qualify for award of the Contract, each bidder should have, in the last five years, achieved in any one year a minimum financial turnover certified by a Chartered Accountant, with at least 75% from construction works. ( Turnover of Rs. 658.20Lakhs)

Class-I Contractors registered in PWD / CPWD and enrolled in Panchayath Raj Engineering Department (Government of Karnataka) are eligible to participate. Award of contract depends on technical capability, work carrying capacity and financial capability.
The Employer reserves the right to reject one or all tenders without assigning any reasons.

Units, rates and prices shall be quoted by the tenderer in Indian Rupees only. Items for which no rate or price has been entered may be executed by the Employer at the other rates and prices in the Bill of Quantities.

Item rates quoted shall include all duties, taxes other than applicable GST, royalties and other levies payable by the Contractor under the Contract, including material curing, loading/unloading, leads and lifts, labour, machinery/equipment hire charges and other incidental charges. All items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government Orders.
As per Government Order LD/300/LET/2006 dated 01-01-2007 and Government Letter No. PW/134/BMS/2007, 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare Fund.
All formats prescribed in the Bid Document shall be filled by the tenderer completely, otherwise the tender will be rejected.

Evidence of ownership of major construction equipment specified in Clause 4.4 B(b)(i) of ITB, or evidence of arrangement for hire/lease/purchase, shall be uploaded. Original scanned copies of purchase invoice / RC Book / Sale documents or duly attested hire/lease agreement and ownership proof shall be submitted as specified.

Contractor should upload experience in works of similar nature and size for each of the last five years, and details of works contractually committed, with certificates from the concerned officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent.
Contractor should upload details of the technical personnel proposed to be employed for the Contract having the qualifications defined in Clause 4.4 B(b)(ii) of ITB.

Line of credit and availability of other financial resources/facilities equal to 10% of the contract value (Rs. 87.76Lakhs) should be certified by a Standard Commercial Bank, the certificate being not more than 3 months old and unconditional.

Contractor should have satisfactorily completed, as prime Contractor or sub-contractor, at least one similar work equal to the estimated cost of work, excluding maintenance cost for five years, for which the bid is invited, or such higher amount as specified in the ITB.

As per Clause 13.2 of ITB, the Bidder is not required to quote rates for Routine Maintenance and 6th Year Renewal. The rates for maintenance and 6th Year Renewal by the Employer are indicated in the Bill of Quantities.

The successful bidder shall deliver to the Employer, in the forms given in Clause 30 of ITB, within 10 days from issue of Letter of Acceptance, Performance Security equivalent to 2.5% of the Contract Price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders.
The Performance Security Deposit held by the Department shall be released/refunded to the Contractor after the period specified, as per SBD Clauses 43.1 to 43.5 of GCC.
Materials required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and shall be tested by the Quality Control authorities as required.

The Field Laboratory, including the testing machines mentioned in the Appendix to ITB, shall preferably be located adjacent to the site. Failure to comply will attract 1% penalty of the amount of work done.
As per Clause 13 of GCC, the Contractor shall, at his own cost, provide insurance cover in the joint names of the Employer and the Contractor for the required amount of construction items.

The awarded Contractor has to submit bills through e-MB for payment. Billing is through e-MB, i.e., the Contractor has to produce the e-MB for RA Bill or Final Bill for payments, as per G.O. No. FD 56 Pro.Cell 2004, dated 18-01-2005.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Tenderer should satisfy the requirements as per SBD (Standard Bidding Document).
Other criteria as mentioned in the Standard Bidding Document shall also apply.
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant documents pertaining to the tender.

Contractors who are terminated from KRRDA for non-completion of works or for not maintaining PMGSY/NGNRY roads, or who do not satisfy the criteria mentioned in Clause 4.7 of Section 2 (ITB) of the Standard Bidding Document, are not eligible for participating in the tendering process.

For any changes either in tender dates or any other conditions, or if the tender is recalled, tenderers can view the changes in the KPPP Portal. Separate notification in this regard will not be published. For further information regarding the tendered work, the concerned Executive Engineer, Project Division, Ballari may be contacted.
While Executing the work if any forest department approval borne will be get cleared by the contractor with his own risk. No any compansation will be paid by the department.
